title: Android app type returns non_ascii_unsupported — adb cannot type Korean
symptom: On Android, typing Korean text with app type ends with non_ascii_unsupported
cause: Android input uses adb input text, which accepts ASCII only
fix: If an English or numeric value works instead, use it
If Korean text is required, ask the user before installing an IME such as ADBKeyboard
Otherwise, ask the user to type it themselves
